purpose: Coordinator-owned dedicated RocksDB campaign; no worker service execution. Each pair starts A then B during A SLEEP. Inspect every statement and final persisted state; conflicts may surface at either write or COMMIT.

cases.name: absent_guard_write_conflict
cases.a: BEGIN; UPSERT decision_guard:absent SET revision=(revision ?? 0)+1; SLEEP 2s; CREATE decision_effect:a; COMMIT;
cases.b: BEGIN; UPSERT decision_guard:absent SET revision=(revision ?? 0)+1; CREATE decision_effect:b; COMMIT;
cases.assertion: At most one effect commits from overlapping snapshots; retry loser with fresh snapshot succeeds. Guard revision then equals 2.

cases.name: read_only_named_record_is_insufficient
cases.setup: UPSERT decision_gate:one SET open=true,revision=0; DELETE decision_effect;
cases.a: BEGIN; LET $gate=SELECT * FROM ONLY decision_gate:one; SLEEP 2s; IF $gate.open { CREATE decision_effect:read_only; }; COMMIT;
cases.b: BEGIN; UPDATE decision_gate:one SET open=false,revision+=1; COMMIT;
cases.assertion: Both may commit: negative control demonstrating stale read-only admission.

cases.name: all_stripes_cut_conflicts
cases.setup: UPSERT decision_stripe:zero SET era=1,revision=0; UPSERT decision_stripe:one SET era=1,revision=0; DELETE decision_effect;
cases.a: BEGIN; LET $gate=SELECT * FROM ONLY decision_stripe:zero FOR UPDATE; IF $gate.era!=1 { THROW 'fenced'; }; UPDATE decision_stripe:zero SET revision+=1; SLEEP 2s; CREATE decision_effect:old; COMMIT;
cases.b: BEGIN; UPDATE decision_stripe:zero,decision_stripe:one SET era=2,revision+=1; COMMIT;
cases.assertion: Overlapping old effect and era cut cannot both commit. Retry old request after cut refuses.

cases.name: predicate_phantom_negative
cases.a: BEGIN; LET $incoming=SELECT VALUE id FROM decision_hold WHERE object='x' LIMIT 1; SLEEP 2s; IF array::len($incoming)=0 { CREATE decision_effect:retired; }; COMMIT;
cases.b: BEGIN; CREATE decision_hold:new SET object='x'; COMMIT;
cases.assertion: Both may commit: phantom negative control; range read alone cannot protect retirement.

cases.name: target_guard_protects_reference_predicate
cases.setup: UPSERT decision_guard:x SET revision=0; DELETE decision_hold; DELETE decision_effect;
cases.a: BEGIN; UPDATE decision_guard:x SET revision+=1; LET $incoming=SELECT VALUE id FROM decision_hold WHERE object='x' LIMIT 1; SLEEP 2s; IF array::len($incoming)=0 { CREATE decision_effect:retired; }; COMMIT;
cases.b: BEGIN; UPDATE decision_guard:x SET revision+=1; CREATE decision_hold:new SET object='x'; COMMIT;
cases.assertion: Both competing operations cannot commit from overlapping snapshots; retry must re-evaluate actual incoming hold. Same experiment models outcome-reference/history predicate.

cases.name: fused_late_collision_rollback
cases.setup: DELETE decision_row; DELETE decision_hold; UPSERT decision_row:collision SET bytes='old';
cases.a: BEGIN; CREATE decision_row:new SET bytes='new'; CREATE decision_hold:new SET object=decision_row:new; LET $actual=SELECT VALUE bytes FROM ONLY decision_row:collision; IF $actual!='changed' { THROW 'late collision'; }; UPDATE decision_row:collision SET bytes='changed'; COMMIT;
cases.assertion: THROW leaves no decision_row:new or decision_hold:new and collision bytes stay old.
